raw: | An export mapping's **array container** is written with an entity and association, so the MDL makes the author declare `Assoc/Entity` twice and the result matches no Studio Pro document | Studio Pro leaves the container BARE — 93 of the 93 entity-less object elements in the demo apps are array containers of the shape `et=Array entity=- assoc=- oh=Find` over `et=Object entity=… assoc=… oh=Find` at the `\|(Object)` step (AgentCommons.EM_Agent, MxGenAIConnector.EM_ConverseRequest, SnowflakeIntegration.Export_AnyChart_Heatmap) | `mdl/executor/cmd_export_mappings.go` (the array branch of `buildExportMappingElementModel`, `exportArrayItemToPrint`) | Declare an array like a plain nested object — `Assoc/Entity as items { values }` — and GENERATE the container, the same rule #248 applied to a root array; only the object handling differs (Parameter on the root's item, Find on a nested one). **Keep honouring the old two-level spelling as written**: `Assoc/Entity as items { ItemAssoc/ItemEntity as ItemsItem { … } }` names TWO entities, one per level, which the bare-container shape cannot express — rewriting it produced **CE0295** "Association … is not allowed" because the item's association no longer reached its parent. It is also what DESCRIBE emitted before the change, so the doctype suite and any script in the wild use it; the integration run caught this, a unit test would not have. DESCRIBE unwraps only the BARE container (discriminate on the stored paths — the item's is the container's plus `\|(Object)` — never on `Kind`, which the two engines' readers label differently), so an old-form mapping still round-trips to its own shape. **An entity-less PLAIN object element is a different thing**, written `group as toolConfig { … }`, and it may hold **object elements only** — a value under one is **CE0061 "No entity selected."**, because a value has no entity to bind its attribute to. That constraint cost a detour worth copying: the first attempt put a value there, mxbuild refused it, and the syntax was withdrawn on the assumption that the SHAPE was unsupported. Transplanting the shipped document (`MxGenAIConnector.EM_ConverseRequest`) into an 11.13 project and checking it — **0 errors** — showed the shape was fine and the reproduction was not. **When a build error contradicts a shipped marketplace module, check the module itself before believing the construct is unsupported**; the demo corpus is a ready-made oracle for exactly that. Two traps in setting that check up: a base project another session has **upgraded** (local-test-app moved to 11.14) makes mxbuild refuse the whole file, and renaming a v2 `.mpr` needs `mprcontents/mprname` updated or the loader throws `StorageMprNameDiscrepancyException`. Repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/mapping-262-export-array-container.mdl`, test `TestExportNestedArrayContainerIsBare`. Issue ako/mxcli#262 |
